title: Rav Chaviva son of Rava
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman mentions him once in a halakhic discussion, in Avodah Zarah 34b, saying: “This grape pomace of Arameans is permitted after twelve months.” Hyman reports that Dikdukei Soferim reads Rav Acha son of Rava.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The saved Vilna Rashi digital comment on Avodah Zarah 34b defines פורצני as grape refuse, supporting “grape pomace.” The William Davidson paragraph assigns this ruling to Rav Acha son of Rav Ika and the following ruling about dark jars to Rav Acha son of Rava, differing from Hyman’s Chaviva heading and reported Acha son of Rava reading.
Hyman’s Chaviva heading and his report about Dikdukei Soferim are retained without harmonizing the three patronymics or claiming a new collation of Dikdukei Soferim.
